title: Comparison #{id}: recording #{a} → #{b}
no_common_music: No common music found: the recordings cannot be overlaid. Before/after needs two recordings of the same record side.
alignment_info: Alignment: {anchors} anchors{quality}. No clicks matched, no differences computed.
repeatability_hint: Two uncleaned recordings: the differences here are the measurement uncertainty. Only an improvement from cleaning that is clearly larger than this is real.
alignment_uncertain: Alignment uncertain (too few music anchors). Read the click matching with caution.
skip_relative: Groove skip at {a} (before) / {b} (after): {meaning} ({grooves}). The click matching after this point is uncertain.
skip_same_place: Skip at the same spot in both recordings ({times}): more likely damage to the record than a setup issue (or a loop in the music; please listen).
spectrograms: Spectrograms, mapped onto the time axis of the before recording
